tcgcsv-87422.headline: Up 82% on the year: Mewtwo (Legends Awakened) 11/146 went from $89.75 on Oct 23, 2025 to $163.01 on Oct 28, and is up 4% over 7 days and up 11% over 30 days. That is its highest price on file, back to Feb 8, 2024, above the earlier peak of $157.23 on Oct 17. That beats its set over 30 days: up 11% against a +1.7% median for 44 Legends Awakened items priced $5.00 or more, and +0.6% for 9912 priced items across the market.
